summary: The department will issue absence notices to students who participated in the 2026 Jeongong Hana (전공하나) programme. Students must complete the attached form, have it stamped at the department office (Room 319), and submit it to the professor of each course, who will decide whether to approve it.
applies_to: Students who participated in the 2026 Jeongong Hana (전공하나) programme.
steps: Download the attached form "2026 전공하나 참가확인서_서식(결석계).hwp" (2026 Jeongong Hana Participation Confirmation Form (Absence Notice)).
Fill in the course name (교과목명), student ID number (학번) and name (성명) on the form.
Take the printed form to the department office (학부사무실), Room 319, and have it stamped with the official seal (직인).
Submit the stamped form to the professor of each course concerned. Each professor will decide whether to approve it.
translation:
Title: 2026 Jeongong Hana (전공하나) Participation Confirmation (Absence Notice) [결석계]

Note: the Korean title reads "잠가확인서", which appears to be a typing error for "참가확인서" (participation confirmation).

Absence notices (결석계) will be issued to students who participated in the 2026 Jeongong Hana (전공하나) programme.

Please refer to the attached participation confirmation form, fill in [course name (교과목명), student ID number (학번), name (성명)], print it, have it stamped with the official seal (직인) at the department office (학부사무실, Room 319), and then submit it to the professor of each course.

(The professor of each course will decide whether to approve it.)

Other enquiries: the department administrative office (학부행정실). The contact details are given in the original notice.

Attachment (1 file): 2026 전공하나 참가확인서_서식(결석계).hwp (349 KB). The content of this attachment was not read.
